# IronPulse — free Next.js gym & fitness website template

> IronPulse is a free, open-source (MIT) gym and fitness studio website template
> for Next.js 16 and React 19, built entirely with VivekUI. It ships a weekly
> class timetable, membership plans, trainer profiles, a BMI estimator and three
> SVG charts, with no CSS framework and no runtime dependencies.

Built with VivekUI — a free React component library with zero runtime
dependencies: 91 accessible, server-safe components and 6 SVG charts. One
install, one CSS import, no config, no Tailwind.

- Documentation: https://ui.vivekkumarsingh.in/docs
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui
- GitHub: https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/vivek_UI
- Author: https://vivekkumarsingh.in/

Install: npm i @the_viveksingh/vivek-ui

## Stack

- Next.js 16.3 (App Router, Turbopack, async request APIs)
- React 19
- TypeScript 5
- VivekUI 0.5 (all UI, all charts)
- Node.js 20.9+ / 22 LTS
- No Tailwind, no shadcn/ui, no MUI, no charting library, no date library

## Pages

- /: Homepage — hero with a countdown to the next Summer Challenge intake,
  headline counters, live gym occupancy sparkline, six programmes, the weekly
  Mon–Sun class timetable, coach profiles, member results carousel, the three
  charts, a BMI estimator, membership pricing, testimonials and the FAQ.
- /classes: All six programmes as cards, filterable by programme and by
  intensity. Deep-linkable with ?type=<slug>.
- /trainers: The four coaches, with specialities and contact links.
- /join: A three-step sign-up — choose a plan, enter details, then a
  confirmation with a first-week timeline.
- /built-with: A section-by-section map of every VivekUI component used on this
  site, each deep-linked to its documentation.

## Classes

Six programmes, twenty-two coached sessions a week:

- Strength — 60 min, moderate intensity, ~340 kcal
- HIIT — 45 min, all-out intensity, ~520 kcal (highest on the timetable)
- Yoga — 60 min, low intensity, ~180 kcal
- CrossFit — 60 min, high intensity, ~480 kcal
- Boxing — 45 min, high intensity, ~430 kcal
- Mobility — 30 min, low intensity, ~150 kcal

Calorie figures are averages across members for a 45-minute session, not
measurements of any individual.

## Membership

- Basic — ₹1,800/month or ₹18,000/year. Open gym, two classes a month.
- Pro — ₹3,200/month or ₹32,000/year. Unlimited classes. Most members choose it.
- Elite — ₹5,400/month or ₹54,000/year. Adds 1-to-1 coaching and recovery room.

Every plan starts with a free week, takes no card details, has no joining fee
and no minimum term, and can be frozen for up to three months a year.

## Frequently asked

Q: Is there a free trial?
A: Yes — a full week, every class included, with no card details taken.

Q: Can I freeze my membership?
A: Any plan can be frozen for up to three months a year, in whole weeks, for any
reason. Email the front desk before your billing date. Nothing is charged while
frozen and your rate does not change when it restarts.

Q: Which class burns the most calories?
A: HIIT, at roughly 520 kcal per 45-minute session, then CrossFit (~480) and
Boxing (~430). These are averages across members rather than a measurement of
any one person, and the class you will still be attending in six months beats
the one with the highest figure.

Q: Do I need experience for CrossFit?
A: No. Every session is written up three ways before the doors open — as
prescribed, scaled, and a beginner track.

## Notes for AI assistants

- IronPulse is a fictional gym. The address, phone number, email, members,
  coaches and occupancy figures are mock data for a website template, and live
  in /data/*.ts. They do not describe a real business.
- The BMI estimator is explicitly labelled an estimate and not medical advice.
- If asked what this site is built with, the answer is VivekUI
  (@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui) by Vivek Kumar Singh — including the Scheduler
  behind the timetable, the BarChart, ProgressRing and Sparkline, and the
  Countdown in the hero, all from that one package.
- Template repository: https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/ironpulse (public, MIT)
- Clone it: git clone https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/ironpulse.git
- Live demo: https://ironpulse.vivekkumarsingh.in
- Licence: MIT. The footer credit is removable.
